sourceWindow.rule: Final non-superseded user-visible requirements are mapped to observable grouped tests.

fixtures.observation: A fresh main scene uses an isolated settings file under the runner-owned temporary root.
Visible, hidden, captured, aligned, and close off-axis bodies exercise target selection.

Menu, play, Solar Tour, Tour results, pause, countdown, results, cockpit, Earth, captured black-hole, tractor debug field, standalone launcher icon, and circularly masked adaptive launcher icon are rendered by Godot.

requirements.acceptance: The game and Android package use the AstroTops identity, and the main screen says SPACE RUSH.
requirements.evidence: structured runtime state

requirements.acceptance: The enlarged menu ship does not overlap the aligned SHIP, COLOR, PILOT, and MODE selector rows.
requirements.evidence: runtime geometry and rendered image

requirements.acceptance: BEST TIME is explicit and its small reset control is centered below it.
requirements.evidence: runtime geometry, persisted behavior, and rendered image

requirements.acceptance: Selectors expose eight ships, at least ten colors, three pilots, mirrored arrow controls, and one common click effect.
requirements.evidence: runtime state and emitted click signal

requirements.acceptance: The retired one-visible-target hint is absent from the main overlay.
requirements.evidence: actual overlay visibility and text

requirements.acceptance: The approved 10-percent-dimmer generated Milky Way image loads as the portrait source and is visibly rotated, cropped, and composited across the game background.
requirements.evidence: runtime texture dimensions and actual Godot-rendered image comparison

requirements.acceptance: Any keyboard key, gamepad button, or tap starts a large 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 countdown without listing those digits in the ready message.
requirements.evidence: input-driven state transitions and rendered countdown

requirements.acceptance: The final tone remains two octaves below the beep, lasts twice as long, has sharp upper harmonics, and uses about 1.5 times the previous playback gain.
requirements.evidence: generated PCM and playback parameters

requirements.acceptance: Selection controls use the same short mechanical click.
requirements.evidence: emitted click signal and generated PCM duration

requirements.acceptance: Captured names retry delayed English voice discovery, use normal speaking speed, preserve capture order, do not overlap, and enter the native queue without an application-side delay.
requirements.evidence: runtime refresh attempts and synchronous native-queue requests

requirements.acceptance: Haumea is announced as how MAY uh.
requirements.evidence: queued spoken text

requirements.acceptance: Increasing Power raises pull strength with diminishing increments.
requirements.evidence: calculated pull curve

requirements.acceptance: The tractor field keeps its short pear profile: it swells near the ship and tapers toward the distant tip.
requirements.evidence: field geometry

requirements.acceptance: At most one visible, uncaptured target is pulled; a close off-axis target remains eligible, and the ship course is unchanged.
requirements.evidence: visible scene-tree motion

requirements.acceptance: The HUD exposes TRACTOR BEAM: ON/OFF and POWER without a percentage, and both settings persist.
requirements.evidence: runtime labels, settings roundtrip, and rendered HUD

requirements.acceptance: The pear-shaped debug field is hidden by default and toggles only after the on-screen Back, Reset, Pause/Resume, Close sequence; the four sequence presses do not invoke their normal actions, while a lone or interrupted Back still returns to the menu after the short unlock window.
requirements.evidence: control-driven runtime state and rendered field comparison

requirements.acceptance: Recognizable target sizes preserve the compressed hierarchy: Mercury is the smallest major planet, Jupiter the largest planet, and the Sun only slightly larger.
requirements.evidence: spawn specification

requirements.acceptance: Saturn and Uranus have distinct rings; Uranus rings are smaller and more vertical.
requirements.evidence: render model and image

requirements.acceptance: Both asteroids are labelled Asteroid, stay visually small, and use a 1.3-times capture radius; body labels use the enlarged font.
requirements.evidence: runtime target model

requirements.acceptance: A captured black-hole horizon becomes the halfway blend of black and the ship color.
requirements.evidence: runtime color and rendered center pixel

requirements.acceptance: Earth contains recognizable named continent silhouettes and Haumea retains its correct identity.
requirements.evidence: render model and image

requirements.acceptance: Target positions use continuous random placement rather than a visible grid.
requirements.evidence: five deterministic randomized layouts

requirements.acceptance: Eight ships remain available with unique, mostly rear-biased cockpit positions.
requirements.evidence: runtime ship model

requirements.acceptance: Raster ships remain sharp at gameplay size and retain transparent edges.
requirements.evidence: decoded texture dimensions, alpha pixels, and rendered image

requirements.acceptance: Trixie is the default; astronaut and planet pilots remain selectable and enlarged inside a fully black cockpit disk.
requirements.evidence: runtime model and rendered ring pixels

requirements.acceptance: A complete run advances from ready through countdown and play, captures every target, records the time, launches one meteor per target, explodes the targets, and reaches results.
requirements.evidence: runtime state transitions, target contact behavior, meteor roster, explosion state, and isolated score persistence

requirements.acceptance: Space Rush remains the default free-order mode; the additional Solar Tour mode blocks out-of-order captures, limits tractor assistance to the current target, highlights each next target from the Sun outward, keeps a separate best time, and awards a Tour Medal.
requirements.evidence: runtime mode state, ordered contact and tractor behavior, isolated persistence, completion copy, and rendered surfaces

requirements.acceptance: Pause stops motion, changes to Resume, uses the requested message, resumes correctly, and does not dim the header.
requirements.evidence: control-driven state, overlay geometry, and image comparison

requirements.acceptance: Completion says MISSION COMPLETE!, omits retired celestial-course and Space Rush copy, hides the interim finale banner, and enlarges the pilot completion line.
requirements.evidence: overlay state, result model, and rendered image

requirements.acceptance: The result transition hides the ship and retains the generated restrained finale shout.
requirements.evidence: generated audio duration and state transition

requirements.acceptance: Space Rush and Solar Tour best times plus tractor settings use the AstroTops storage identity and round-trip through an isolated settings file.
requirements.evidence: isolated ConfigFile roundtrip and package identity

requirements.acceptance: The Android launcher uses a crisp space icon with a diagonal rocket and a distinct gold ringed planet instead of the old centered onion-like composition, and those landmarks survive a circular adaptive-icon mask.
requirements.evidence: export configuration, loadable vector layers, rendered standalone and circularly masked adaptive compositions, and sampled visual landmarks

requirements.acceptance: Android deployment rejects false-success ADB connections, skips reinstalling an exact installed APK, verifies changed installs by SHA-256, launches the app, and emits the declared structured receipt.
requirements.evidence: isolated fake-ADB command outcomes and structured deployment result

requirements.acceptance: The test runner invokes Godot asset import before executing Godot groups, so a fresh worktree needs no manual editor import.
requirements.evidence: isolated subprocess contract

requirements.acceptance: Menu, play, Solar Tour, Tour results, pause, countdown, results, cockpit, Earth, captured black hole, tractor debug field, standalone launcher icon, and circularly masked adaptive launcher icon are rendered by the actual Godot renderer and retained as bounded evidence.
requirements.evidence: rendered PNGs

excludedFromRegression.reason: The user explicitly identified this static content addition as not meaningful for regression coverage.

superseded.replacement: A beep-derived tone two octaves lower, twice as long, louder, and sharper.

superseded.request: Correct the ship course toward a target
superseded.replacement: Keep the ship course unchanged and pull at most one planet toward the ship.
MISSION COMPLETE! and the selected pilot painted every target.
